verdict.rationale: Qodo's code-review docs say each finding explains how to fix the issue and that you can 'let Qodo apply the fix directly', which covers the core idea of applying review fixes in place. The evidence does not show that suggestions appear as committable diffs in the PR comment or that applying them takes one click. missing for 10: explicit documentation of suggested-diff blocks in review comments, a one-click commit/apply mechanism in the Git provider UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
